_howto: Managed hosting partners for the one-click column and the hosting note on category pages. After joining each affiliate program, replace url with your referral link. Until then these are plain links and earn nothing. The site marks all of them rel=sponsored automatically.
_rule: Only relevant offers: hosting or deployment of open-source apps. Do not add the proprietary SaaS itself or unrelated banners; they do not convert and they cost trust and rankings.
_verifyPayout: Check payout terms before adding a partner. Some pay in credits rather than cash (Hetzner did); leave those out or set managed to false.
